status: Frozen after owner decisions D1 to D4 and before measured-series capture

ownerDecisions.D1: A settled answer with an operation failure is a valid observation in its arm. Incomplete usage, changed catalogues, replay misses, unfinished responses and interruptions remain technical missingness.
ownerDecisions.D2: Manual replay is reported separately from the 15-task replay primary analysis. Off-arm copy mismatches remain reliability findings. A replay block is one task, arm and repeat cell.
ownerDecisions.D3: Include all eight reserve rows for 20 measured tasks without changing their exposure labels.
ownerDecisions.D4: Accept a live population dominated by branch-only fetch for now, with claims restricted accordingly. The owner will make a final integration judgement after assessment.
ownerDecisions.D1Capture: Permit one failed-capture rerun with a new identity and recorded reason. Its replay cells can use the recaptured fixture while the failed capture remains retained.
ownerDecisions.D2Budget: A budget-limited tool call with a settled answer for every prompt is a valid task outcome. Provider, transport, catalogue, replay, usage and unfinished-response failures remain technical missingness.

population.orderRule: Interleave arms by seed 20261102, task and repeat. Require paired measured live and replay executions. Retain global order in the append-only inventory. Do not add, remove or substitute tasks or repeats.

endpoints.historicalHypothesis: 50% uncached-input saving is a hypothesis, not a completion requirement

uncertainty.method: Paired task-cluster bootstrap with task means over repeats
uncertainty.completeCaseRule: Also emit complete-case intervals explicitly labelled diagnostic. Per-workflow estimates are descriptive and carry no interval.

claimRules.saving: Report an uncached-input saving only when the primary ratio upper bound is below 1 and both judges meet the quality rule.
claimRules.fiftyPercentSaving: Support the historical 50% hypothesis only when the primary ratio upper bound is at most 0.5 and both judges meet the quality rule.
claimRules.increasedInput: Report increased uncached input when the primary ratio lower bound exceeds 1.
claimRules.noDemonstratedEffect: A primary interval including 1 is no demonstrated token effect, not proof of no effect.
claimRules.insufficientPrecision: An unavailable interval or a quality interval that cannot exclude the declared margin is insufficient precision, not a small demonstrated effect.
claimRules.qualityConflict: If judges disagree about the quality rule, report the conflict and do not average or select a judge.
claimRules.cacheReporting: Report total input alongside uncached input. Do not interpret an uncached-only change as a total-context reduction.

quality.scale: Integer 0 to 4, holistic overall score treated as an ordinal diagnostic difference scale
quality.rule: Analyse each judge separately. Preserved quality requires the on-minus-off lower confidence bound above -0.5. A point estimate below -0.5 is a descriptive loss; use bounds for claims.
quality.inspectionRule: Inspect every answer whose overall judge scores differ by at least 2 points and every task whose paired off-minus-on direction differs between judges by at least 2 points. Retain all disagreements and do not adjudicate by preference.
quality.agreementReporting: Report exact agreement, within-one agreement, tie-direction disagreements and skew. Do not present high within-one agreement as proof of judge reliability.
quality.calibrationDisposition: Both judges matched the owner on all four trivial synthetic sanity checks. This is weak prompt-following evidence, not judge validation.
quality.judgeHarnessRule: Record harness versions. Judge 2 may use Pi 1.5.0 while study execution remains pinned to Pi 1.4.0; disclose this asymmetry.
quality.sessionRule: One isolated fresh session per packet and judge, with tools disabled and coordinator-owned provenance
quality.searchSummaryRule: A material claim supported only by a search summary caps provenance at 2. Retain this pilot rule because summaries are discovery leads, not independent source evidence; report its arm-distribution limitation.

missingData.primaryRule: Technical missingness makes the affected endpoint unavailable. A failed operation with a settled visible answer remains a valid observation and a reliability outcome.
missingData.sensitivity: Scored failed and invalid answers also enter the separately labelled diagnostic sensitivity estimates with complete-case intervals.
missingData.captureFailure: A failed capture has no replay fixture. One technical recapture gets a new identity and recorded reason; its fixture is shared by both replay arms while the failed capture remains retained.
missingData.completion: An inconclusive or unavailable primary result is reportable and does not permit selective deletion or replacement of trials.

contextExposure.definition: Count characters from retrieved page material in actual main-model requests, including tool arguments, results, script output, errors and spill-file reads. Count repeated exposure per request. Exact quotations of retrieved page text are identified separately from whole-page exposure.
contextExposure.source: actual-requests.ndjson correlated with captured source identities and canonical messages

claims: Estimate effects only for this build, pinned Pi 1.4.0 host, prescribed models and declared 20-task population.
Keep controlled replay and unforced live populations separate. Replay timing and replay pipeline cash are not live speed or new-cash measures.
Manual replay is descriptive reliability evidence outside the 15-task replay primary analysis.
Live claims are restricted to the observed branch-only-fetch-dominated behaviour; controlled replay carries full-pipeline evidence.
Per-workflow estimates are descriptive with no interval.
Report neutral, negative and inconclusive results, quality disagreements, missing data and spend.
Make no cross-host, cross-model, general-superiority or preserved-quality claim from token counts alone.

pilotBasis.overallAgreement: 18 of 32 exact; 32 of 32 within one point; maximum difference 1; tie-direction disagreements are also reported
pilotBasis.precisionDisposition: The owner accepted the reserve expansion after reviewing precision limits of the 12-task design.

execution.stoppingRule: Apply the canonical admission rule and the existing phase cost, fixture-validity and failure-retention rules. Do not infer zero from missing charges.
